thread:
Incident Bot: URGENT: tenant=sparrow-health-prod p99 streaming latency breach detected > 6s (alert time=1965433089).
Alex Chen: I'm on. Can someone grab current concurrency and streaming stall rates?
Mira Patel: Pulling metrics now. Concurrent sessions for that tenant jumped from ~140 -> ~1.9k in ~40s. Streaming stall ratio up to 18%, p95 ~700ms, p99 ~6-13s depending on route.
Jamal Ortiz: Runtime logs show repeated KV cache churn and a small set of very long prefixes being repeatedly reprocessed; lots of duplicate session IDs from reconnects.
Li Wei: Node metrics: several workers hitting high GPU SM utilization and memory pressure; queue length spiking. Connection fd counts high on a subset of pods.
Support - Priya: Sparrow Health reports they just kicked off a backfill ingestion job sending huge clinical notes with repeated metadata headers per prompt. They didn't expect streaming.
Alex Chen: Likely long-context + repeated header patterns causing KV thrash and increased backend work per token. We need quick mitigations: 1) per-tenant connection cap 2) enable smaller quantized fallback 3) short-lived prefix caching 4) dedupe reconnects. Who can apply caps?
Li Wei: I can push a tenant circuit breaker and session cap. Applying connection_limit=350 and session_creation_block_after=500/min now.
SRE Bot: Policy applied: tenant=sparrow-health-prod connection_limit=350 at 1965433201.
Mira Patel: Also pushing a dynamic routing rule: prefer model=gpt-ctx-2-q4 when estimated_tokens>4096 for this tenant. This should reduce GPU time per token.
Jamal Ortiz: Enabling request dedupe on websocket handshake to drop duplicate stream resumes for same session token within 5s window. That should reduce the reconnect-amplified load.
Alex Chen: Do it. Also enable prefix aggregation cache for the tenant with TTL=25s; that should stop re-decoding identical headers.
Li Wei: Command executed: `redwoodctl tenant set-policy --tenant sparrow-health-prod --cache.prefix_ttl 25s` applied at 1965433245.
Mira Patel: Shortly after mitigation: streaming stall ratio down from 18% -> 5%, p99 trending down to ~1.2s. Some long requests still above p95.
Support - Priya: Sparrow Health engineers will pause the backfill job for 30 minutes and shard their batches to smaller sizes. They agreed to our temp limits.
Jamal Ortiz: Noted a codepath bug where kv_cache eviction was skipping aggregated prefixes under heavy churn; creating internal ticket RG-4410. Attaching minimal logs to the ticket.
Taylor Nguyen: I'm taking the handoff. Can someone paste the exact mitigation timestamps and commands for the post-incident doc?
Mira Patel: Mitigation timeline: 1965433201 connection cap, 1965433220 model fallback rule active, 1965433245 prefix cache TTL set, 1965433260 websocket dedupe enabled, 1965433280 session rate limit enforced.
Alex Chen: Add a short-term recommendation: implement tenant-specific model profiles for known long-doc workloads and surface guidance in docs for safe ingestion patterns. Long-term: fix KV eviction correctness and add early-detection runbooks for prefix fanout.
Li Wei: Also added a temporary dashboard alert to fire if single-tenant concurrency jumps > 800 in 1m with streaming p99 > 2s.
SRE Bot: Alert rule created at 1965433333.
Mira Patel: Monitoring shows steady improvement. We'll keep the tenant caps in place for 45min and then relax gradually if stable.
Support - Priya: I'll coordinate a follow-up with the Sparrow Health CSM and schedule a joint engineering call to review ingestion patterns and best practices.
Taylor Nguyen: Copy. I'm drafting the post-incident summary and will include links and the RG-4410 tracking id. Leaving monitoring in my name for the next 40m.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Please drop any replay harnesses or config diffs here for the postmortem.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll add a small repro harness that reproduces repeated-header long prompts + reconnects to the RG-4410 ticket.
Incident Bot: Handoff complete. Paging closed; ongoing monitoring assigned to Taylor Nguyen.
